what_this_is: The falsified-text manifest for the EC6 end-of-life (ABEX) repair. It records every claim in the LIVE course that charging the plan's abandonment cost falsifies, with the rebuilt digest line that settles each one. It recuts nothing: a later wave recuts the lessons, the banks and the capstone rows from this manifest.
defect: The FDP teaching lab called runScenario and runFdpSensitivity with no abandonment argument. EGINA carries an ABEX cost item of 260 and UKOT one of 190, and neither reached any cash flow, so the whole course taught a field development plan that never pays to abandon the field.
verification: All five were reproduced by calling engines main 709172f directly, and again through the vendored copy, before anything was written. The thirteen unmoved graded values were reproduced character for character on both, so only a real engine move is declared a move.

irr_field_decision.replacement: ukot_base_irr_low_root_pct = -43.22592817326132, tol 0.01, labelled as the lower of the two rates at which the Board case NPV is zero
why: The engine refuses a single IRR for this flow and returns irr null with irrStatus multiple-roots. A numerically graded field cannot grade a null, so the field had to be redesigned rather than reseeded, as EC2's non-discriminating capex-loss field was.
Both roots ARE engine return values (metrics.irrRoots), so grading one grades an engine answer and not a hand computation.

The HIGHER root, 37.65929157034489, was rejected on evidence: it sits 0.00974 from the retired answer of 37.66903234346082, INSIDE the retired tolerance of 0.01, so a learner who ran the pre-repair case would score full marks on the repaired field. That is precisely the non-discriminating shape the EC2 audit retired.
A root COUNT of 2 was rejected: a small integer answer collides with half the teaching digest and discriminates nothing, a gotcha this wave already recorded when it dropped a payback field.

The LOWER root cannot be reached by any single-IRR method: not by the pre-repair engine, not by Newton from a ten percent guess, not by negating or averaging the roots. Producing it requires reading that there are two, which is the judgement the repair exposes.
The tier still holds exactly six graded fields, and no graded value depends on a held or disputed literature item: every one is a return value of the sanctioned screening engine on stated inputs.
irr_field_decision.discrimination_evidence: Seven naive routes checked; the closest (the higher root negated) misses by 556.7 tolerances, the pre-repair single rate by 8089.5. 0 WEAK.
irr_field_decision.gates_rerun_on_the_new_field: digestleak 0, collisions 0 fatal, promptleak 0 cross-tier and 0 same-tier.

failure_modes_named_wrongly.finding: 30 USD a barrel is no longer the multiple-roots case. Charging the end-of-life cost turns it no-root, and turns the EARNING cases (70, 48, 92 USD) into the multiple-root ones. Four items name the failure mode wrongly because of it.
failure_modes_named_wrongly.note: advanced/m02/l03 is the worst of them: its whole contrast is 'at 30.0000 the status is multiple-roots and at 18.0000 it is no-root', and both halves are now the same status. The repair also hands that lesson a far better example than the published short-price-deck case it reaches for: the plan's own base case.

failure_modes_named_wrongly.finding: Eight items teach that the ABEX line reaches no cash flow. It now falls in the final production year and is deductible for tax there.
failure_modes_named_wrongly.settled_by: Engine totals: CAPEX 2250.0000, OPEX 95.0000 a year. The ABEX line of 260.0000 is in neither of those two totals (derived), because it is neither development capex nor an annual operating cost. It is the plan's end-of-life cost and the case carries it in the final production year.

recorded_not_fixed: THE SUITE APP CANNOT YET PRODUCE THESE ANSWERS. petrolord-suite main vendors an FDP engine with no resolveAbandonment at all, and src/components/fdp/modules/scenarios/ScenarioManager.jsx calls runScenario(scenario, concept) with no abandonment. Until the Suite is repaired and shipped, a learner sitting this capstone in the FDP Accelerator sees the pre-repair numbers. The Suite repair is a prerequisite for the recut going live, not for this branch.

scenarioPayback takes no abandonment argument, so the payback the card shows is the payback of a plan that never pays to abandon. On these cases it changes nothing because the cost falls in the last year, but on a plan that only recovers at the end it would. The digest says so in Section 4.

Vendoring the remaining engines/economics/fdp files (the reserves-against-profile check, the H2S partial-pressure screen, an empty schedule spanning null, and the newer goldens with seven more published plan cases) moves twelve further digest lines and is a separate wave. Measured, not guessed: the digest was rebuilt against that tree to count them.

The lab constant STRESS_PRICES.multipleRoots was renamed alsoNoRoot, because 30 USD a barrel is no longer a multiple-roots case. A constant whose name asserts a retired status is the same defect class as a golden case name that does.
